title: The Key Marked Do Not Use
summary: A school caretaker locks the hungry infected out with one ring of keys, and finds that one key opens something she never expected.

beats.text: I am the school caretaker, with eleven keys. Tonight the infected filled the corridor.
Every door I locked bought me ten more steps.
My ring held a gym key, a boiler key, a roof key, and one marked Do Not Use.
The gym was full. The boiler room was full. The roof was locked outside.
That left the old basement door I was told never to open.
I turned the last key. The door opened on a warm room.
Eleven children looked up from sleeping bags. A boy held a torch.
They had hidden there nine days, leaving crumbs upstairs. I had blamed the mice.
I locked us in and gave each child a key.
At dawn the girl asked what the roof key opens. I smiled. A rescue.
